product_metadata.title: Cille Water Bottle 24oz Hot Water Bottle Stainless Steel BPA Free Insulated Water Bottle for Cycling Vacuum Cold Water Bottle with Double Wall Wide Mouth Thermos Metal Water Bottles (Red)
features: PREMIUM DOUBLE WALL INSULATION TECHNOLOGY: This stainless steel water bottles has a powerful double wall insulation technology that will keep your drink at the right temperature until the very last sip. In fact, our reusable water bottle can keep cold drinks cool for 24 hours, and hot drinks warm for 12 hours.

THERE WON’T BE ANY LEAK OR SPILL ACCIDENTS: The spout of this cool insulated water bottle allows for easy drinking and pouring, however, it will never leak. Thanks to its secure, airtight lid, the Cille stainless steel bottle will never leak when you store it in your bag, next to your books and documents, your phone or your laptop.

NO WATER RINGS AND BURNED HANDS: Even if the content of the metal water bottle is ice cold, the outer walls won’t sweat. At the same time, if the content is boiling hot, your hands won’t get burned. Our smart double wall design ensures that the temperatures in and out of the insulated bottle do not affect each other.

IDEAL FOR SPORTS, OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES AND TRAVELING: The stylish Cille double walled water bottle can be used by both women and men, adults and kids. Thanks to its leakproof design and premium insulation, the double walled insulated bottle is ideal for sports, exercising, traveling, camping, hiking, backpacking and more.

ABSOLUTELY SAFE MATERIALS FOR ADULTS AND KIDS: This reusable insulated water bottle is made with robust materials that ensure its durability. Apart from durable, these materials are also 100% nontoxic and BPA-free, so you can rest assured that the stainless steel vacuum water bottle is absolutely safe for you and your loved ones.
